title: Linked Movements · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Linked Movements · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and agree on three small, safe gestures. The pair alternates performing the three gestures in the agreed order. All three gestures occur in order without overlap. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Linked Movements, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All three gestures occur in order without overlap.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: All three gestures occur in order without overlap.
